public_rationale: Scene-consistency failures do not by themselves establish that the system lacks any scene-wide representation. OpenAI also reports spatial and temporal consistency capabilities, which complicate that inference without proving comprehension. The retrieved record supplies neither a systematic local-versus-global error assessment nor a decisive study of the original model’s representations. The stronger claim therefore remains unsettled.
limitations: The outcome depends on preserving the strength of any global comprehension rather than reducing it to occasional inconsistency.
Company demonstrations are selected examples, not a representative evaluation.
Later models cannot settle the internal properties of the February 2024 model.
